# Helvety Contacts

> Encrypted Helvety Contacts Rolodex—names through notes stay client-side until ciphertext lands in storage; list filtering runs locally post-unlock. MIT, Switzerland.

## Canonical URL
- [Contacts App](https://helvety.com/contacts): Auth-required contacts route

## Crawling And Indexing
- Contacts routes are intended not to be indexed.
- These routes are not intended as crawl targets and are protected by noindex metadata and authentication controls.
